caseName: Horsman Dolls, Inc. v. Unemployment Compensation Commission
caseNameFull: Horsman Dolls, Inc. v. Unemployment Compensation Commission
attorneys: Samuel Kaufman and Nathan Bidder for appellant-petitioner., Theodore D. Parsons, Attorney General of New Jersey, Joseph A. Murphy, Assistant Deputy Attorney General, Herman D. Ringle and Charles A. Malloy for appellee-respondent.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The motion to dismiss is granted and the

appeal is dismissed for want of jurisdiction, 28 U. S. C. § 1257 (2). The petition for writ of certiorari is denied.
